column1: # The muzzle devices' stats (docs/notes/attachments-muzzles.md): what each key of 0.69d0's two drop
# modifications of a device (at its bought grade, 7) becomes on a 0.26g weapon. devices.py applies it.
#   same   the same value on our key (a share of the gun's own value: modifier type 2)
#   as     dead on the guns the device fits (make_pack.py checks why against the players' weapon
#          configs): the device takes instead what 0.69d0 rolls first on the devices whose one key
#          the named one is. The slowdown on a hit is 0.26g's parameters/stopping_power, and the
#          slow from a hit is capped at 0.5 (the stagger 0x2DBCD0), under what those guns have
#          already: such a compensator takes a brake's recoil
#   axes   the two pellet axes are one spread in 0.26g: the mean of the two (an axis the device does
#          not change counts 0)
#   look   the device's main effect has no 0.26g key: it changes the look alone, and its other
#          modification is dropped too (the owner, 2026-11-21: flash hiders change the look only)
#   none   no 0.26g key without new exe code: dropped
# `recoil` is the six kick bounds recoil/min_ and max_top, _left, _right_recoil, as the stock recoil
# rolls 2080.. scale them (docs/notes/weapon-rolls.md).
